== Overview ==

'''MessagingProtocol''' provides a mailbox-style messaging system. Messages are sent to either a single user or to every participant of a [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]], and are stored on the server until the recipient retrieves them.

This protocol only handles receiving incoming messages from clients, storing them for later use. It does not handle the live delivery of messages. [[NEX/Protocols/MessageDeliveryProtocol|MessageDeliveryProtocol]] is used to deliver messages from the server to the recipient.

=== DeliverMessage ===

Accepts a message to be stored in a recipients mailbox.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#CustomDataHolder|CustomDataHolder]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt; || oUserMessage || The incoming message
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#CustomDataHolder|CustomDataHolder]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt; || oModifiedMessage || The message as it was stored by the server, with the server-populated fields filled in
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;UInt32&gt; || lstSandboxNodeId || Connection IDs (<code>RVCID</code>) of the recipients the message was delivered to
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[NEX/Types#PID|PID]]&gt; || lstParticipants || [[NEX/Types#PID|PIDs]] of the recipients the message was delivered to. Nintendo's servers have been observed sending garbage values here?
|}

=== GetNumberOfMessages ===

Returns the number of messages waiting for a recipient.

If the caller is not allowed to access the recipient, the server returns <code>0</code> rather than an error.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#MessageRecipient]] || recipient || The mailbox to check
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || uiNbMessages || Number of messages waiting for the recipient
|}

=== GetMessagesHeaders ===

Returns only the headers of the messages waiting for a recipient, without their bodies.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#MessageRecipient]] || recipient || The mailbox to check
|-
| [[NEX/Types#ResultRange|ResultRange]] || range || Range of messages to return
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt; || lstMsgHeaders || Headers of the messages in the requested range
|}

=== RetrieveAllMessagesWithinRange ===

Returns the complete messages waiting for a recipient, bodies included.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#MessageRecipient]] || recipient || The mailbox to retrieve from
|-
| [[NEX/Types#ResultRange|ResultRange]] || range || Range of messages to return
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[NEX/Types#CustomDataHolder|CustomDataHolder]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt;&gt; || lstMessages || The messages in the requested range
|}

=== RetrieveMessages ===

Returns specific messages by their IDs.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#MessageRecipient]] || recipient || The mailbox to retrieve from
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;UInt32&gt; || lstMsgIDs || IDs of the messages to retrieve
|-
| Boolean || bLeaveOnServer || If <code>false</code>, the retrieved messages are deleted from the server once they have been sent to the caller
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[NEX/Types#CustomDataHolder|CustomDataHolder]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt;&gt; || lstMessages || The requested messages
|}

=== DeleteMessages ===

Deletes specific messages by their IDs.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#MessageRecipient]] || recipient || The mailbox to delete from
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;UInt32&gt; || lstMessagesToDelete || IDs of the messages to delete
|}

==== Response ====

This method does not return anything.

=== DeleteAllMessages ===

Deletes every message waiting for a recipient.

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[#MessageRecipient]] || recipient || The mailbox to empty
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| UInt32 || uiNbDeletedMessages || Number of messages which were deleted
|}

=== DeliverMessageMultiTarget ===

Identical to [[#DeliverMessage]], but sends the same message to several recipients at once.

Only [[NEX/Types#PID|PIDs]] can be targeted with this method. There seems to be no way to send to multiple [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gatherings]].

==== Request ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[NEX/Types#PID|PID]]&gt; || lstTarget || Users to send the message to
|-
| [[NEX/Types#CustomDataHolder|CustomDataHolder]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt; || oUserMessage || The message being sent
|}

==== Response ====

{| class="wikitable"
! Type !! Name !! Description
|-
| [[NEX/Types#CustomDataHolder|CustomDataHolder]]&lt;[[#UserMessage]]&gt; || oModifiedMessage || The message as it was stored by the server, with the server-populated fields filled in
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;UInt32&gt; || lstSandboxNodeId || Connection IDs (<code>RVCID</code>) of the recipients the message was delivered to
|-
| [[NEX/Types#List|List]]&lt;[[NEX/Types#PID|PID]]&gt; || lstParticipants || [[NEX/Types#PID|PIDs]] of the recipients the message was delivered to. Nintendo's servers have been observed sending garbage values here?
|}

== Classes ==

=== MessageRecipient ===

Identifies the mailbox a method operates on. This is either a single user or a [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]], depending on <code>m_uiRecipientType</code>.

<tabs items="Original,NEX 4.0.0+" storagekey="MessageRecipient">
	<tab name="Original">
		{| class="wikitable"
		! Type !! Name !! Description
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_idRecipient || ID of the recipient. Either a [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] or a [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID, depending on <code>m_uiRecipientType</code>
		|-
		| [[#RecipientType]] || m_uiRecipientType || The type of the recipient
		|}
	</tab>

	<tab name="NEX 4.0.0+">
		In NEX 4.0.0 the single recipient ID was split into two dedicated fields, one for each [[#RecipientType]].

		{| class="wikitable"
		! Type !! Name !! Description
		|-
		| [[#RecipientType]] || m_uiRecipientType || The type of the recipient
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_principalId || [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the recipient. Only used when <code>m_uiRecipientType</code> is <code>PrincipalID</code>
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_gatheringId || [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID of the recipient. Only used when <code>m_uiRecipientType</code> is <code>GatheringID</code>
		|}
	</tab>
</tabs>

=== UserMessage ===

{{ClassInherits|path=NEX/Types|Data}}

Base class for all other message types. Can be seen used by itself in rare cases, but usually only child classes are used.

Messages can be tied to other messages in a parent-child structure, forming the ability to create replies/comments/etc.

Several fields are populated by the server rather than the sender, and are overwritten with the servers own values if the client sets them.

<tabs items="Original,NEX 4.0.0+" storagekey="UserMessage">
	<tab name="Original">
		{| class="wikitable"
		! Type !! Name !! Description
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_uiID || Unique ID of the message. Set by the server
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_idRecipient || ID of the recipient. Either a [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] or a [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]] ID, depending on <code>m_uiRecipientType</code>
		|-
		| [[#RecipientType]] || m_uiRecipientType || The type of the recipient
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_uiParentID || Parent message ID
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_pidSender || [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the sender. Set by the server
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] || m_receptiontime || Time the server recieved the message. Set by the server
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_uiLifeTime || How long the server should keep the message around for before automatically deleting it?
		|-
		| [[#MessageFlag]] || m_uiFlags || How the message should be delivered
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strSubject || Subject of the message. May be at most <code>MAX_STR_SUBJECT_LENGTH</code> characters
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strSender || Username of the sender. Set by the server
		|}
	</tab>

	<tab name="NEX 4.0.0+">
		In NEX 4.0.0 the recipient fields were replaced with a [[#MessageRecipient]], moved to the end of the class.

		{| class="wikitable"
		! Type !! Name !! Description
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_uiID || Unique ID of the message. Set by the server
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_uiParentID || Parent message ID
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] || m_pidSender || [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]] of the sender. Set by the server
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#DateTime|DateTime]] || m_receptiontime || Time the server recieved the message. Set by the server
		|-
		| UInt32 || m_uiLifeTime || How long the server should keep the message around for before automatically deleting it?
		|-
		| [[#MessageFlag]] || m_uiFlags || How the message should be delivered
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strSubject || Subject of the message. May be at most <code>MAX_STR_SUBJECT_LENGTH</code> characters
		|-
		| [[NEX/Types#String|String]] || m_strSender || Username of the sender. Set by the server
		|-
		| [[#MessageRecipient]] || m_messageRecipient || The recipient of the message
		|}
	</tab>
</tabs>

== Constants ==

{{Noticebox|''The real names of these constants are not known. The names used here follow the naming conventions of the equivalent [[NEX/Protocols/DataStoreProtocol#Constants|DataStoreProtocol]] constants. Only their values are known.''}}

{| class="wikitable"
! Name !! Type !! Value !! Description
|-
| <code>MAX_STR_SUBJECT_LENGTH</code> || UInt32 || 60 || The max length a [[#UserMessage]] subject can be. Longer subjects are truncated by the server rather than rejected
|-
| <code>MAX_STRING_LENGTH</code> || UInt32 || 256 || The max length a [[#TextMessage]] body can be
|-
| <code>MAX_BINARY_SIZE</code> || UInt32 || 512 || The max size a [[#BinaryMessage]] body can be
|}

== Enums ==

=== RecipientType ===

Determines what kind of recipient the message is intended for.

<pre>
enum RecipientType : uint32_t {
  ...
};
</pre>

{| class="wikitable"
! Name !! Value !! Description
|-
| <code>PrincipalID</code> || 1 || A single user. The recipient ID is the users [[NEX/Types#PID|PID]]
|-
| <code>GatheringID</code> || 2 || A [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]]. The recipient ID is the [[NEX/Protocols/MatchMakingProtocol/Types#Gathering|Gathering]]. The recipient ID is the gathering ID, and the message is available/sent to all participants of the gathering
|}

== Flags ==

=== MessageFlag ===

Determines how a message is delivered to its recipient.

<pre>
enum MessageFlag : uint32_t {
  ...
};
</pre>

{| class="wikitable"
! Name !! Value !! Description
|-
| <code>PersistentMessage</code> || 0x00 || The message is stored on the server until the recipient retrieves it
|-
| <code>InstantMessage</code> || 0x01 || The message is both stored on the server and immediately delivered to the recipient through [[NEX/Protocols/MessageDeliveryProtocol|MessageDeliveryProtocol]]
|}
